name: JSurfaceNets
definition: An isosurface extraction algorithm that generates a quad-mesh by placing vertices at the average of edge-crossing points on the grid cells, serving as a substitute for Marching Cubes.
summary: JSurfaceNets is an isosurface extraction algorithm that generates a quad-mesh by placing vertices at the average of edge-crossing points, offering simpler topology and faster computation than Marching Cubes.
